headword: {労働|ろうどう}{組合|くみあい}

definitions.gloss: labor union; trade union; workers' union
definitions.explanation: An organized association of workers formed to protect and advance their collective interests, including wages, working conditions, and benefits.

examples.japanese: {労働|ろうどう}{組合|くみあい}に{加入|かにゅう}する。
{労働|ろうどう}{組合|くみあい}が{賃上|ちんあ}げを{要求|ようきゅう}した。
examples.english: The labor union demanded a wage increase.

examples.japanese: この{会社|かいしゃ}には{労働|ろうどう}{組合|くみあい}がないので、{従業員|じゅうぎょういん}が{個別|こべつ}に{交渉|こうしょう}するしかない。
examples.english: This company has no labor union, so employees have no choice but to negotiate individually.

notes:
USAGE:
Often abbreviated to {労組|ろうそ} in news and informal contexts. In Japan, enterprise unions ({企業別|きぎょうべつ}{組合|くみあい}) organized by company are more common than industry-wide unions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {労働|ろうどう}{組合|くみあい}に{入|はい}る (to join a union)
- {労働|ろうどう}{組合|くみあい}の{委員長|いいんちょう} (union chairperson)
- {労働|ろうどう}{組合|くみあい}と{交渉|こうしょう}する (to negotiate with the union)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {労組|ろうそ}: labor union — common abbreviation
- {組合|くみあい}: union, association — broader term for any cooperative organization
